A combination of education and experience that is at least the equivalent of (A) and/or (B) above. Candidates making an application based on equivalency must submit a Supplemental Application for Equivalency Determination (Download PDF reader) in addition to all other required materials.

items.item_text: 01. Describe a concept within a community college or university level Physics course that students might find difficult. Explain how you would teach this concept to a class with a wide range of mathematical preparation.

02. Describe an instance when you used course data, assessment results, or student feedback to identify a gap in outcomes among your students. What did you change and what was the result? If you have not had this opportunity yet, describe how you would approach this in your future classes at Irvine Valley College.
Master’s in physics, astronomy or astrophysics

A combination of education and experience that is at least the equivalent of (A) and/or (B) above. Candidates making an application based on equivalency must submit a Supplemental Application for Equivalency Determination (Download PDF reader) in addition to all other required materials.
At least two (2) years of experience teaching Physics courses, consisting of both lecture and laboratory components, at the community college or university level.
Experience participating in academic committees and workgroups that support and advance participatory governance.
Experience with curriculum development and academic program review.
Experience using evidence-based, active-learning pedagogies in Physics instruction at the community college or university level.
Experience designing course materials using Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles and digital accessibility standards.
Experience using sensor-based data acquisition software and hardware.
Must meet one of the following qualifications under (A) through (C):

Commitment to equity and diversity. All applicants must have demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, faculty, and staff. The applicant must be able to demonstrate how these factors relate to the need for equity minded practices within an educational environment.
